model.name: TAKE-OVER diffs (per-hunk left->center / right->center)
model.description: Per-hunk take-over buttons: left->center and right->center (+ the reverse) apply a diff hunk into the center pane, incrementally building the merged file.

acceptanceCriteria.text: Per-hunk buttons: left->center and right->center (+ the reverse center->side) to take over a diff hunk.
Applying take-overs incrementally BUILDS the center merged file from the chosen hunks.
